topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can't believe this, I just can't. We've been friends for so long, and you telling me all this time you work at this fancy firm, and it's not even true? It's like, okay, I get it, we all want to make a good impression, but why couldn’t you just come clean, tell me the real story? I wish you trusted me enough to share what’s really going on. We could have figured it out together, you know? Now, I don’t know what to think, but I do know I’m here for you, always. Just tell me the truth, please. We’ll work through this, but you’ve got to start being honest.
